title: Scales and keys
summary: Build any major scale from one formula, find its relative minor, and read key signatures with the circle of fifths. Project: your scale sheet.

videos.title: Music theory for dum-dums, full beginner course (Piano With Corey)

practice.question: Why is it useful to know a song's scale?
options: It lists every chord in the song in order
It gives you the set of notes the melody and chords mostly use, so you know which keys to reach for
It tells you the tempo
It is only needed for reading sheet music
practice.explanation: A song mostly uses the seven notes of its scale. Knowing the scale narrows twelve possible notes down to seven, which makes finding melodies and chords much faster.

practice.question: Which pattern builds a major scale from any root?
options: W H W W H W W
W W W H W W H
W W H W W W H
H W W W H W W
practice.explanation: Major is W W H W W W H, or 2 2 1 2 2 2 1 half steps. On the white keys from C, the half steps fall at E-F and B-C.

practice.question: Someone writes F major as F G A A# C D E. What is wrong?
options: Nothing, A# and Bb are the same key
The fourth note should be written Bb, so each letter appears once
The fourth note should be B
The scale should start on C
practice.explanation: A# and Bb are the same key, but a major scale uses each letter once. With A# there are two As and no B. The correct spelling is F G A Bb C D E.

practice.question: You are asked to play in A major. Which notes are black keys?
options: F#, C# and G#
Bb and Eb
F# only
C# and D#
practice.explanation: Apply W W H W W W H from A: A B C# D E F# G#. The black keys are C#, F# and G#.

practice.question: What is the formula for the natural minor scale?
options: W W H W W W H
W H W W H W W
H W W H W W W
W H W W W H W
practice.explanation: Natural minor is W H W W H W W. From A that gives A B C D E F G, all white keys. Compared with major, the 3rd, 6th and 7th are a half step lower.

practice.question: A song switches from F major to its relative minor for the bridge. Which minor key is that?
options: F minor
A minor
D minor
C minor
practice.explanation: The relative minor is the 6th note of the major scale: F G A Bb C D, so D. Or count three half steps down from F: E, Eb, D. F minor would be the parallel minor.

practice.question: In a song in A minor you hear a G# leading back to A. Where does the G# come from?
options: It is a mistake
The harmonic minor scale, which raises the 7th
The relative major
A minor always has G#
practice.explanation: Harmonic minor raises the 7th note so it sits a half step below the root. In A that turns G into G#, which pulls strongly back to A.

lessons.title: Key signatures and the circle of fifths

practice.question: A chord chart shows two sharps at the start of each line. Which major key is it?
options: G major
D major
A major
Bb major
practice.explanation: Sharps are added in the order F#, C#, G#... Two sharps means F# and C#. The key is a half step above the last sharp: C# up a half step is D. (It could also be the relative minor, B minor.)

practice.question: A chart has three flats: Bb, Eb and Ab. Which major key is it in?
options: Ab major
Bb major
Eb major
F major
practice.explanation: For flat keys, the key is the second-to-last flat. Bb, Eb, Ab: the second-to-last is Eb, so Eb major (or its relative, C minor).

practice.question: On the circle of fifths, what happens each time you move one step clockwise?
options: The key goes up a fourth and adds a flat
The key goes up a fifth and adds a sharp (or loses a flat)
The key goes up a half step
The key changes from major to minor
practice.explanation: Clockwise is up a fifth, seven half steps: C, G, D, A... Each step adds one sharp, or removes one flat on the flat side (Eb -> Bb -> F).

project.title: Your scale sheet
checklist: C, G, D, F and Bb major written out with correct letter names
W W H W W W H marked between the notes of each major scale
Relative minor of each key written: A, E, B, D and G natural minor
Number of sharps or flats written next to each key
All five major scales played up and down, hands separately, at a steady speed
All five relative minor scales played up and down
One major scale and its relative minor recorded back to back
The five keys placed on a hand-drawn circle of fifths
